items.title: Why Malaysia’s Health Care Financing Model Is Mathematically Unsustainable
items.summary: Malaysia’s health financing model is fundamentally unsustainable because most Malaysians don't pay income tax. This is also the reason why a mandatory NHI scheme isn't feasible. MediAsas is also just a mirage because it's just private health insurance. The post Why Malaysia’s Health Care Financing Model Is Mathematically Unsustainable appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Declare Nicotine Vape Illegal As Poison, Stop Collecting Tax: MPs
items.summary: Petaling Jaya and Kuala Langat MPs tell the government to ban nicotine vape as a scheduled poison under the Poisons Act and to stop collecting excise duties on it, saying MOF must also refund businesses over RM354m in excise duties collected since 2023. items.title: Explainer: Three Options For Putrajaya After Withdrawing Nicotine Appeal
items.summary: The government has 3 options to take after dropping its nicotine appeal. Option A: Ban nicotine vape. Option B: Return to the Poisons Board.
